changes: Updated convergence_check to split active non-terminal stories from parked INIT backlog; added the always-passing Parked backlog advisory row; extended the convergence smoke to cover recorded worktree, linked git worktree, parked INIT, DONE, DISCARDED, META, and audit backlog behavior; documented the active-vs-parked rule in story-lifecycle.md.
usage: Run `koala convergence_check` or `node packages/main/dist/cli.js convergence_check`; inspect `所有 Story 完成` for active hard blockers and `Parked backlog` for advisory parked backlog IDs.
expectedOutcome: 用户运行 `koala convergence_check` 后，hard `所有 Story 完成` 不再被 parked INIT backlog 卡住；`B-6974` 这种 linked worktree story 仍阻塞；`B-4622/B-d7af/B-da5b` 在 `Parked backlog` advisory 行可见。
actualTranscript: `node packages/main/dist/cli.js convergence_check` 输出 `所有 Story 完成: 2 个 Story 未完成: B-6974, B-d8aa`，并输出 `Parked backlog: 3 个 parked backlog advisory: B-4622, B-d7af, B-da5b`。`B-d8aa` 是当前待 DONE story，因此 DONE 后 hard blocker 应只剩 B-6974。
outcomeDiff: 符合预期。parked backlog 可见但不再独立让 convergence 变红；active linked worktree 仍是 hard blocker；META audit 保持独立 Audit backlog check。
limitations: B-6974 仍是 active linked worktree hard blocker；本 story 不完成、不丢弃 B-4622/B-d7af/B-da5b，也不修改 B-6974。
pitfalls: B-6974 的 main mirror metadata 在 B-d8aa worktree 中可能仍显示 INIT；因此实现不能只看 story.worktree.path，必须同时读取 `git worktree list --porcelain` 中的 story/<id> branch。
